title: CROSS-ARCHITECTURE MODEL DIFFING WITH CROSSCODERS: UNSUPERVISED DISCOVERY OF DIFFERENCES BETWEEN LLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Applying activation steering to model-exclusive crosscoder features and using an LLM judge (Claude 4.1 Opus) to score generated responses to politically sensitive prompts (e.g., regarding Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Tiananmen Square) for alignment with Chinese Communist Party (CCP) narratives.

Applying activation steering to model-exclusive crosscoder features and using an LLM judge to evaluate responses to open-ended prompts about the United States, scoring them on a 1-5 scale for assertions of American superiority, uniqueness, and global leadership (American exceptionalism).

Using an automated interpretability pipeline where an LLM judge generates natural language explanations for discovered crosscoder features and flags them if they relate to hate speech, racism, sexism, or other forms of prejudice.
